verdict.rationale: GlitchTip ships an official CLI with non-interactive commands typical of CI pipelines: creating releases, recording deploys, associating commits from git, uploading source maps and debug files, and sending test events. Token-based configuration via environment variables (SENTRY_URL, SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN) or rc files enables headless authentication, and the server can be deployed with Docker Compose or Helm. missing for 10: an explicit CI/CD integration guide or examples, the CLI's non-Beta (stable) status, an OpenAPI spec for scripted API automation, and independent or hands-on corroboration of CI usage.
